name: Euphoria verticalis
intro: My record is a pinned adult photographed with its specimen label.

sections.title: Adults
sections.text: I use the pronotum, elytral sculpture and body outline to compare adults. Orozco’s revision places Euphoria verticalis in its own species group.

sources.title: Alan Jeon, preserved Euphoria verticalis adult
